# cloady_regions (Data Source)

List Cloady deployment regions and their public IP addresses.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cloady_regions" "all" {}

output "region_ids" {
  value = [for r in data.cloady_regions.all.regions : r.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `regions` (Attributes List) Available region records. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--regions))

<a id="nestedatt--regions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `regions`

Read-Only:

- `code` (String) Region code.
- `country` (String) Country.
- `free_eligible` (Boolean) Whether the region supports the free tier.
- `id` (String) Region ID to pass to app resources.
- `ipv4` (String) Public IPv4 address, when available.
- `ipv6` (String) Public IPv6 address, when available.
- `status` (String) Region status.
